records.researcher_notes: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists generator 5 at Marion, plant 976, as operating, 75 MW, natural gas combustion turbine, operating since May 2003. The EIA annual generation survey for 2024, which I read from a file on disk, shows the plant's gas turbines generated about 113,500 megawatt-hours that year, so they ran. Both come from the Energy Information Administration, so this is one source. An Illinois Country Living article from 2020 also says the cooperative still has two natural gas units after Unit 4 closed. No source says these units are mothballed. This is a status change from mothballed, so it needs a second publisher. I found no document that says unit 5 is mothballed or gives a date for that step. EIA lists it as operating.

records.researcher_notes: The August 2026 EIA monthly generator table places Joliet 9, plant code 874, at 41.4931, -88.1153. That is Joliet 29, which a Power Engineering article says lies across the river from Joliet 9. The imagery date is unknown. The EIA table shows this unit retired in June 2023 with 360.4 MW, which agrees with GEM. I found no document that states anything about carbon capture for this unit, and no document that gives the city in a field I could cite.
